conventions.scale_note: Clock positions from manuals were converted linearly: 7:00 = 0, 12:00 = 5, 5:00 = 10 (one hour = 1.0). Fractal-derived numbers are Fractal knob values; treat every start as a starting point, not a calibrated match.
conventions.direction_note: 'brighter'/'tighter' give the direction to move that control for a brighter tone / tighter low end. For switches 'up' = on/engaged, 'down' = off. 'n/a' = no reliable effect or direction not documented.
conventions.output_note: OUTPUT (dB) on every amp block is a clean level trim with no tonal effect; use it to re-match loudness after changing MASTER, SAT, PULL GAIN or MIDCUT.

gain_advice.text: Mesa (JP-2C manual): players have applied too much gain ever since it was invented; 'use enough gain to get the job done and no more'. As GAIN goes up, BASS should come down.
Mesa (Rectifier manual): 'Don't turn the Gain all the way up'; the amp is designed to give its gain at less than extreme settings.
Diezel (Herbert/VH4 manuals): 'less is often more'; start every control at 12:00; reduce gain with high-output pickups.
Peavey (6505 manual): rhythm channel pre gain 0-4; set pre gain for the overdrive you want, then post gain for volume.
Nail The Mix (Gojira/Nolly amp-sim tones): use less gain than you think you need to keep articulation; boost the DI before the amp instead.
Typical boosted-amp numbers: amp GAIN 3.5-5 on 5150/Rectifier-type amps with a boost at drive 0 and level 8-10; 5-6.5 unboosted.

boost_recipe.text: Classic tightening boost: Tube Screamer-type pedal with drive at or just above 0, tone around noon, level near max. It cuts lows before the preamp (tighter palm mutes), adds a mid hump and hits the first stage harder.

cab_conventions.speaker: Celestion Vintage 30
cab_conventions.text: Upper-mid forward with tight lows; the modern-metal default, especially in Mesa oversized 4x12s. Mesa-made V30s are voiced differently from regular ones.

cab_conventions.speaker: Celestion G12T-75
cab_conventions.text: Scooped mids, bright top, extended lows; the stock 1980s Marshall 1960A speaker, associated with thrash and JCM800/900 tones; can sound thin or harsh alone.

cab_conventions.speaker: Celestion Greenback (G12M)
cab_conventions.text: Warm, woody mid-heavy voice with softer lows and early breakup (25 W); classic rock and hot-rodded Marshall tones, less suited to tight low-tuned metal.

cab_conventions.speaker: Mixes
cab_conventions.text: V30 + G12T-75 (Bogner Ubercab) or V30 + Greenback (Friedman-style) blends are common to balance mid push against scoop/warmth.

special_cases_for_software: mesa_rectifier 1018 (Modern): no power-amp negative feedback. PRESENCE is a preamp high-cut with a much lower useful range; MASTER above ~2-3 makes it darker and flubbier, not just louder.
mesa_tremoverb: PRESENCE circuit differs per channel (Orange = feedback loop, Red = preamp); do not copy values between 1089 and 1090.
mesa_jp2c: BASS is pre-distortion (lower it to tighten; add lows with '80 Hz'/'240 Hz'). PRES PULL changes the correct PRESENCE range (pulled 0-3, pushed ~6).
peavey_6505 DEPTH, evh_5150iii RESONANCE, archetype_nolly RESONANCE/DEPTH, gojira DEPTH, rabea DEPTH, diezel DEEP, slo plugin DEPTH: power-amp low boost; lower = tighter.
TIGHT knobs (victory_kraken Ch2, archetype_petrucci Rhythm, archetype_rabea Lead) are high-pass filters: higher = tighter, the opposite sense to DEPTH/RESONANCE.
diezel_herbert: INTENSITY and LEVEL do nothing unless MIDCUT is on; LEVEL is make-up volume only.
friedman_be100: SAT and FAT loosen/thicken (turn off to tighten); SAT also drops volume; BASS is meant to run very high.
marshall_jubilee: INPUT GAIN, LEAD MASTER and OUTPUT MASTER all change loudness; only INPUT GAIN is the drive control.
marshall_jcm800 / soldano_slo100: raising MASTER makes the tone darker and smoother; low MASTER is the usual cause of harshness.
fortin_nameless: GAIN I is inactive on INPUT = LOW I; PULL GAIN adds distortion but lowers output.
soldano_slo100_plugin (1170): scales are 0-11 and only the selected CHANNEL's gain/master pair is active.
victory_kraken FOCUS, friedman VOICE, misha VOICE/TREBLE SHIFT, TUBE switches, MOD switches: polarity or effect undocumented; A/B by measurement.
Gojira DRT FILTER is a low-pass that darkens as it rises.
Non-0-10 scales: Tim Henson Acoustic BLEND (-28..0), John Mayer Three-In-One (% and dB), Cory Wong Funk Console (Hz and dB), SLO plugin (0-11), John Mayer Smooth Operator (1-10).
